sentences.text: It depends on the sanction_date: clause 7.4 says 2% plus GST on the principal outstanding for all term loans pre-closed by the borrower, but the in-force RBI Direction says a UCB shall not charge pre-payment charges for existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 to individual borrowers for purposes other than business.
The documents do not state whether the loan was sanctioned before December 31, 2025.
Because that sanction_date is not stated, the documents do not state whether clause 7.4 complies with the RBI prepayment rule for this loan.

missing.searched: searched the loan policy and RBI prepayment rule evidence for the date the floating-rate home loan was sanctioned
